translations.web: You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and Yahweh will not answer you in that day.”
translations.bsb: When that day comes, you will beg for relief from the king you have chosen, but the LORD will not answer you on that day.”
translations.kjv: And ye shall cry out in that day because of your king which ye shall have chosen you; and the LORD will not hear you in that day.
translations.asv: And ye shall cry out in that day because of your king whom ye shall have chosen you; and Jehovah will not answer you in that day.
